note: Source and licence of every image the product shows (Fase 3). Rules are matched top to bottom on the path under /public, first match wins (a '*' matches within one folder level, '**' across levels). A test (imageProvenance.test.ts) fails when an image has no rule, so a new image cannot ship without a recorded source. 'confirm' marks an image whose origin this project could not establish from its own history: it must be confirmed by the owner before the commercial launch.
generatedStatement: Generated with Google's Gemini image model through the API from our own text prompts. No third-party photograph or artwork was used as input. Rights follow Google's terms for generated output at the time of use; this is not a stock or licensed photograph. Check those terms again before commercial launch.
